The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) PROCUREMENT OF DEEP FREEZER – 1000 LITRE CAPACITY

1. Scope of Supply The bidder shall supply one Deep Freezer of approximately 1000 litres capacity, make Blue Star, complet e with all standard accessories, operating instructions and warranty documents. 2. Technical Specifications Make: Blue Star. Type: Deep Freezer. Capacity: Approximately 1000 litres. Temperature Control: Adjustable thermostat for maintaining the required freezing temperature. Cooling System: Efficient compressor-based refrigeration system. Power Supply: 230 V AC, 50 Hz, single phase, or as specified by the manufacturer. Construction: Durable, corrosion-resistant body with an insulated cabinet. Lid/Door: Heavy-duty, well-insulated lid/door with secure closing arrangement. Refrigerant: Environment-friendly refrigerant as per applicable standards. Energy Efficiency: As per the manufacturer's specifications and applicable standards. Accessories: All standard accessories required for installation and operation shall be included. New Equipment: The equipment supplied shall be brand new, unused and of current production. 3. Make and Model The bidder shall quote the Blue Star make and clearly indicate the exact model number, capacity, technical specifications and product details. The offered model must meet the technical requirements specified in th e bid. 4. Warranty A minimum warranty of one year against manufacturing defects shall be provided, or the higher wa rranty period offered by the manufacturer. Warranty shall cover manufacturing defects in the compressor and other components as per the ma nufacturer's warranty policy. The warranty certificate shall be provided along with the equipment. 5. Delivery and Installation Delivery shall be made to the consignee's location specified in the GeM contract. The supplier shall ensure safe transportation and delivery of the equipment without damage. Installation and commissioning, wherever required, shall be carried out by the authorised service pr ovider without additional cost, if included in the contract. The supplier shall provide a demonstration of the equipment's operation to the consignee. 6. Authorised Dealership The bidder should be an authorised dealer/distributor of Blue Star or shall provide the applicable manufact urer authorisation wherever required under the bid conditions and GeM rules. 7. Inspection and Acceptance The equipment shall be inspected by the consignee on delivery. Acceptance shall be subject to verification of quantity, make, model, capacity, physical condition an d compliance with the specifications. Equipment found damaged or not conforming to the specifications shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost, in accordance with the contract terms.

8. Documentation The supplier shall provide the following documents along with the equipment: Tax invoice. Warranty certificate. User manual and operating instructions. Manufacturer's product specifications. Installation and commissioning report, wherever applicable. 9. After-Sales Service The supplier shall provide after-sales service and warranty support through the manufacturer's authorised service network. The supplier shall coordinate with the consignee for resolution of defects during the warra nty period. 10. General Conditions The quoted price shall include all applicable taxes, packing, forwarding, transportation and other ch arges as applicable under the GeM contract. The equipment shall comply with applicable Indian standards and statutory requirements, wherever applicable. All terms and conditions of the GeM bid and resultant contract shall remain applicable. Any condition specified in this ATC shall be read in conjunction with the applicable GeM terms and c onditions. .
